name: tether-in
description: Self-maintaining API integrations powered by oasdiff, Codex, and Greptile

scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json apps packages/config packages/orchestrator packages/local-state packages/git-local packages/github-cli packages/codex-runner packages/greptile/vitest.config.ts scripts/*.ts test playwright.config.ts vitest*.ts && bun run --filter @tetherin/provider-pipeline format:check && bun run --filter @tetherin/greptile format:check
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter @tetherin/web typecheck && bun run --filter @tetherin/runner typecheck
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @tetherin/provider-pipeline build && bun run --filter @tetherin/greptile build && bun run --filter @tetherin/config build && bun run --filter @tetherin/orchestrator build && bun run --filter @tetherin/local-state build && bun run --filter @tetherin/git-local build && bun run --filter @tetherin/github-cli build && bun run --filter @tetherin/codex-runner build
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter @tetherin/runner build && bun run --filter @tetherin/web build
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && bun test test/bun
scripts.test:fixtures: bun run --filter @tetherin/provider-pipeline test:fixture && bun run --filter @tetherin/greptile test:fixtures && vitest run --config vitest.fixture.config.ts
